_comment: The task text an inbox entry turns into (#374). TWO implementations must agree: the
server's `todoTaskText` (src/todos.ts, used by POST /api/todos/:id/start) and the
cockpit's copy (web/app/src/routes/inbox.tsx), which prefills /new with it. They run in
different processes and share no module, so these cases are the contract between them:
test/unit/todo-task-text.test.ts asserts the server against it, inbox.test.tsx asserts the
cockpit. Change one builder and its suite goes red here; update this file and the OTHER
suite goes red too — neither side can drift alone.

cases.name: the suggested prompt wins over the summary
a blank suggested prompt falls back to the summary
suggested args become a trailing Arguments line
args attach to the summary fallback too
an empty summary with no prompt stays empty
